ConfigurationEvent.effectiveDateTime.title: effectiveDateTime
ConfigurationEvent.effectiveDateTime.description: Date and time this event has or will become effective.

FailureEvent.failureIsolationMethod.title: failureIsolationMethod
FailureEvent.failureIsolationMethod.description: How the asset failure was isolated from the system.

ActivityRecord.createdDateTime.title: createdDateTime
ActivityRecord.createdDateTime.description: Date and time this activity record has been created (different from the 'status.dateTime', which is the time of a status change of the associated object, if applicable).

WorkActivityRecord.percentComplete.title: percentComplete
WorkActivityRecord.percentComplete.description: Estimated percentage of completion of this individual work task or overall work order.

Ravens.cimObjectType.title: cimObjectType
Ravens.cimObjectType.description: Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

IdentifiedObject.description.title: description
IdentifiedObject.description.description: The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

EndDeviceEvent.userID.title: userID
EndDeviceEvent.userID.description: (if user initiated) ID of user who initiated this end device event.

FailureEvent.failureDateTime.title: failureDateTime
FailureEvent.failureDateTime.description: Time and date of asset failure.

FailureEvent.faultLocatingMethod.title: faultLocatingMethod
FailureEvent.faultLocatingMethod.description: The method used for locating the faulted part of the asset. For example, cable options include: Cap Discharge-Thumping, Bridge Method, Visual Inspection, Other.

ActivityRecord.type.title: type
ActivityRecord.type.description: Type of event resulting in this activity record.

ActivityRecord.reason.title: reason
ActivityRecord.reason.description: Reason for event resulting in this activity record, typically supplied when user initiated.

EnvironmentalAlert.alertType.title: alertType
EnvironmentalAlert.alertType.description: The type of the issued alert which is drawn from the specified alert type list.

EnvironmentalAlert.cancelledDateTime.title: cancelledDateTime
EnvironmentalAlert.cancelledDateTime.description: Time and date alert cancelled. Used only if alert is cancelled before it expires.

FailureEvent.failureMode.title: failureMode
FailureEvent.failureMode.description: What asset failed to be able to do.

AssetHealthEvent.effectiveDateTime.title: effectiveDateTime
AssetHealthEvent.effectiveDateTime.description: The date and time when the event is effective.

ActivityRecord.severity.title: severity
ActivityRecord.severity.description: Severity level of event resulting in this activity record.

EndDeviceEvent.issuerTrackingID.title: issuerTrackingID
EndDeviceEvent.issuerTrackingID.description: Identifier assigned by the initiator (e.g. retail electric provider) of an end device control action to uniquely identify the demand response event, text message, or other subject of the control action. Can be used when cancelling an event or text message request or to identify the originating event or text message in a consequential end device event.

EndDeviceEvent.issuerID.title: issuerID
EndDeviceEvent.issuerID.description: Unique identifier of the business entity originating an end device control.

ActivityRecord.status.title: status
ActivityRecord.status.description: Information on consequence of event resulting in this activity record.

EnvironmentalAlert.headline.title: headline
EnvironmentalAlert.headline.description:
An abbreviated textual description of the alert issued. 
Note: the full text of the alert appears in the .description attribute (inherited from IdentifiedObject).

EnvironmentalAlert.inEffect.title: inEffect
EnvironmentalAlert.inEffect.description: The interval for which this weather alert is in effect.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName.title: aliasName
IdentifiedObject.aliasName.description:
The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID.title: mRID
IdentifiedObject.mRID.description:
Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name.title: name
IdentifiedObject.name.description: The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

title: ActivityRecord
description: Records activity for an entity at a point in time; activity may be for an event that has already occurred or for a planned activity.
